predictions.rationale: Registers ASP.NET Core Identity, IdentityServer, authentication and token issuance pipelines; central entry point for the Identity service.
Defines IdentityServer resources, clients, scopes and token lifetimes; core to how access tokens are produced and validated.
Handles user login, logout, registration and related account management endpoints directly tied to authentication.
Implements credential validation against the Entity Framework store; part of the login flow used by AccountController.
Supplies user claims to IdentityServer when issuing JWT access tokens; key for protecting resources with proper claims.
Entity Framework context containing ApplicationUser and related identity tables that store user credentials and roles.
Interface abstracting authentication logic; part of the Identity service’s login pipeline.
MVC client façade that initiates login/logout against Identity service and manages user session with access tokens.
Attaches bearer tokens to outgoing HTTP requests from the gateway, enforcing protection of downstream services.
Seeds initial users and roles into the identity database, enabling authentication scenarios out-of-the-box.
